forensic_diagnosis_of_polarity_mismatch.explanation: The exact rejected proposition text and the exact evidence passage text used by CentralClaimVerifier for this specific veto were never persisted anywhere (not in the response, not in TutorTelemetryEvent, not on disk) and the in-memory TutorService/telemetry instance was discarded when the one-shot harness process exited. Re-running the live call to recover this data is explicitly forbidden in this pass. A specific A/B/C/D determination for THIS incident would therefore be fabrication and is not made.
forensic_diagnosis_of_polarity_mismatch.static_code_observation_not_incident_spe: CentralClaimVerifier's polarity veto (src/medicalplab/evidence_engine/claim_verifier.py, condition 3, lines ~89-93) flags POLARITY_MISMATCH if ANY negation term appears anywhere in the evidence text near ANY claim word >4 chars, without requiring the negation and the shared word to be in the same clause/sentence. This is a plausible general false-positive risk against long, multi-sentence real PMC evidence chunks, but this observation does not confirm what happened in this specific incident and must not be used to justify weakening the verifier without direct evidence.
